name: Selene Grancer
original_name: セレーネ・グランセル
source: While Selene always sports a blank expression and is hard to read on the outside, at her core she is a very passionate person, but at the same time a bit spoiled. She has a small body that animals like and because of this, Selene is in charge of feeding [url=/c42835]Spiano's[/url] adopted pets. Though short, she has a very fit body.
